svg.title: Attn moe parallel matrix formula
svg.text: Two token layouts; only one direction needs communication
Replicated → sharded: local slicing, no communication
Sharded → replicated: AllGather costs c · B·d
c = (P−1)/P excludes the local share; r = k/P_EP is routed copies per EP GPU.

g.text: MLA requires P copies of KV
RS on input; AG on output
Common for GQA; KV head sharding
AG on input; RS on output
Preferred for MLA; no KV replication

svg.text: Green: layouts match. Orange: extra input/output conversion.
In units of 2c·B·d: C=1, B=r, A=2, D=1+r. EP saves bytes when r<1.
GQA: attention TP if n_kv ≥ TP. MLA: no KV head axis to shard; use attention DP.
